parameters.content:
## Convert a store export to shopping feeds
1. In **Compile catalog**, select a Header Auth credential named **X-RapidAPI-Key** with your own RapidAPI key as its value.
2. Run the included fictional Shopify sample. One manual run makes one $0.01 API request. Open **Download feed files → Binary**.
3. In **Catalog settings**, replace the CSV, store URL, currency and condition. Set the template to shopify or woocommerce. Enable TikTok only for an eligible catalog.

[Setup, limits and worked example](https://feeds.newbsscraping.com/guides/n8n-product-feeds/)
